name: Hapikuri -Happy Christmas-
source:
Yuji was studying hard for the entrance exams for the university. One day his teacher asked him to coach his junior students in chorus club. As experiencing the difficulty in coaching people, a friendship between Yuji and his juniors is getting firm.
